problem: Full-budget online baseline made limited per-token motion, selected only forward tokens, never contacted cube and did not solve large height gap.
hypothesis: A larger bounded translation step and clamp may increase realized motion per fixed five-frame token, improving progress within 250 physical frames. Teacher action choice and height planning remain separate possible limitations.
reference_boundary: 120mm/hold1 scripted success supports considering amplitude only. This120mm/hold5 is a new uncalibrated candidate, not the proven research profile.

expected_response.comparison: separate by movement direction; report first shared control interval and full run, no mixed-direction score

acceptance.diagnosis: Actual initialstate+goal match, all frozen conditions and causal/physical/media receipts valid; report no improvement or uncertainty honestly.
acceptance.positive_demonstration: Independent native success+tactile audit+causal readback+all-frame video+execution accounting; no known wrong or uncertain labels.
acceptance.adoption: No automatic global interpreter or research-variant adoption; candidate remains explicit per-run version.

limits: two translation fields co-change, not separate identification
closed-loop teacher decisions can change after state differences
no statistical benefit, general calibration or student claims
